name: Eggplant and Chickpea Skillet
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 small eggplant (aubergine) or 2 Italian eggplants, quartered and sliced
2–3 cups (200–250 g) broccoli, cut into small florets

steps: Sauté the green bell pepper and garlic in the oil over medium heat for several minutes. Add mushrooms and eggplant and continue cooking, stirring often, for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, chickpeas and tarragon. Stir well, cover, and simmer for 10–12 minutes until eggplant has softened somewhat.
Stir in the basil leaves and broccoli and simmer, partially covered, for 8–10 minutes or until broccoli is bright green.
Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
